$comment: A reword of support-v2-three-way-v1's routing question, written by hand against the routing family's development partition and against nothing else. The calibration partition scores it; the locked partition is not read.

This candidate changes the instructions and leaves the three criteria descriptions word for word, which is the other half of the pair support-v2-three-way-v2 opens. It carries the same labelling rule in the instruction slot rather than in the answer space, so the two together say which field a caller should spend words on.
The option names billing, technical, and sales are frozen, as is the question type.

routing.instructions: Which team should handle this message? Route on what has to be done about it rather than on the subject it mentions: something that is broken is technical even on an invoice or a payment page, and a limit a larger plan would lift is sales even when it reads as slowness.

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, refunds, and payment problems
criteria.sales: Quotes, plans, upgrades, renewals, and pricing

severity.instructions: How severe is the reported issue?

urgency.instructions: Does this need urgent attention today?

criteria.true: Something is broken, blocked, or unsafe right now
criteria.false: It can wait for the normal queue
